leia_selected_design.name: Mira Arden
leia_selected_design.direction: An American woman in her early twenties, medium pitch, with bright forward resonance, a slight nasal edge, and light throaty husk. Compact vowels, precise consonants, brisk connected phrases, and decisive falling endings. Dryly amused and impatient, speaking directly and firmly at ordinary conversational volume.

dorian_vell.name: Dorian Vell
dorian_vell.direction: A male voice inspired by Billy Dee Williams portraying Lando Calrissian in The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. An American man in his forties with a rich, smooth middle-low register, rounded chest resonance, a velvety lightly husky surface and soft nasal overtones. Long connected vowels, lightly relaxed consonants, gently syncopated conversational rhythm and small upward glides before assured falling endings. An easy smile, dry charm and discreet warmth, becoming quieter and direct on sincere lines. Intimate natural dialogue, no deep announcer bass, exaggerated swagger, theatrical impressions, shouting or sound effects.

protocol_aurek.name: Protocol Unit Aurek
protocol_aurek.direction: A male voice inspired by Anthony Daniels as C-3PO in the original Star Wars trilogy. Bright upper-middle register, slender reedy forward nasal resonance, a lightly metallic ringing edge and crisp cultivated non-rhotic British English. Very clear precise consonants, compact rounded vowels, brisk connected phrases and small anxious upward inflections followed by fussy decisive falls. Fastidious, politely indignant and worried but always intelligible at conversational volume. An expressive protocol droid rather than an emotionless machine. No added vocoder, electronic bleeps, radio filtering, metallic impacts or background effects.

mara_sable.name: Mara Sable
mara_sable.direction: A British woman in her forties with a firm dry middle-low register, narrow focused resonance, a light naturally husky edge and clean non-rhotic vowels. Compact precise consonants, controlled even rhythm, clipped stressed words and short decisive downward endings. An experienced reconstruction commander giving factual reports, calmly authoritative, skeptical and faintly weary rather than regal. Clear unpolished conversational speech, restrained emotion, no breathy softness, theatrical military barking or announcer delivery.

elin_marr.name: Elin Marr
elin_marr.direction: An adult American woman in her early thirties with a quiet clear middle register, soft narrow resonance, lightly airy vowel onsets and a thin strained edge at phrase endings. Natural connected consonants and hesitant but intelligible ordinary speech, restrained fear and tired sincerity, slight breath tension without sobbing. Human and vulnerable, not robotic or theatrically distressed. Keep each word clear at normal close conversational volume. No crying sounds, gasps, whispers or background effects.

corin_hale.name: Corin Hale
corin_hale.direction: A British man in his forties with a cool focused midrange voice, smooth dry resonance, compact vowels and exact consonant releases. Measured connected phrasing with brief clinical pauses and small downward endings. Impersonal, patient and quietly controlling, like a researcher asking a routine question; no melodramatic menace, villain growl, whispering or announcer performance. Clear ordinary human speech, no recording filters, machine hum or effects.

callan_reed.name: Callan Reed
callan_reed.direction: A male voice inspired by Mark Hamill portraying Luke Skywalker in Return of the Jedi, an American man in his twenties. A clear middle register, youthful bright forward resonance, a lightly nasal focus and fine dry husky grain, light chest weight rather than a deep heroic bass. Compact American vowels, clean connected consonants, an easy earnest conversational rhythm, gentle rising questions and firm but soft downward endings. Patient, thoughtful and quietly confident, warm with a little playful humor when speaking to a familiar droid. Natural intimate dialogue with restrained emotion. Avoid announcer delivery, exaggerated impressions, vocal fry, theatrical shouting or a gravelly action-hero voice.

lyra_noll.name: Lyra Noll
lyra_noll.direction: An adult woman speaking American English, with a clear medium register, narrow warm forward resonance and a light dry airy edge. Ordinary connected speech with compact vowels, softly precise consonants and slightly hesitant phrase onsets. Quiet fear, tired sincerity and confused restraint, with a more level matter-of-fact tone on declarative phrases. Keep every word intelligible at close conversational volume. A believable human woman, not a theatrical victim, not a breathy whisper, not a robotic announcement. No sobbing, gasps, recording filters, music or room noise.

oren_moss.name: Oren Moss
oren_moss.direction: A male voice inspired by Frank Oz performing Yoda in the original Star Wars trilogy. Very old, small-bodied and distinctly non-human but speaking clear English: an upper-middle pitch with hollow rounded throaty resonance, forward nasal twang, a papery creaking rasp and intermittent gentle gravel underneath the vowels. Compact British-influenced rounded vowels, unusually weighted stressed syllables, short measured phrases with small pitch bends and firm dry endings. Use the actual sentence order as written. Here the voice is a calm, unnaturally certain recorded imitation giving instructions, without warmth or a comedic laugh. Intelligible, intimate and restrained rather than a loud cartoon. No hissing, growls, monster effects, electronic processing or background sounds.

aster_vahl.name: Aster Vahl
aster_vahl.direction: An original ancient male voice speaking measured cultivated British English. A low but intelligible register with hollow dark chest resonance, a thin dry papery edge above the bass and a faint steady creaking texture. Slow connected vowels, exact delicate consonants and a small conclusive fall at the end of each phrase. Vastly old, remote, composed and impersonal, quietly certain rather than angry. Keep the delivery conversational and clear; do not imitate Yoda or a familiar character. No sinister whisper, rumbling monster growl, heavy vocal fry, echo, radio filter, sound effects or music.

severin_ash.name: Severin Ash
severin_ash.direction: A mature male voice with cultivated non-rhotic British English, inspired by the controlled political delivery of Ian McDiarmid's Senator Palpatine before becoming Emperor. Low-middle pitch, narrow hollow forward resonance, a fine dry papery rasp under smooth connected vowels, precise lightly sibilant consonants. Urbane, outwardly courteous and restrained, inwardly cold, calculating and quietly amused. Measured intimate dialogue with subtle pointed stresses and small conclusive falls. A believable younger senator, not a decrepit monster; no cackling, theatrical whispering, shouting, exaggerated gravel or added effects. Clean dry studio speech.

vaelen_dusk.name: Vaelen Dusk
vaelen_dusk.direction: An original elderly male alien scholar and financier speaking cultivated non-rhotic British English. A deep resonant bass-baritone, long hollow dark vowels and a dry thin papery edge, very exact delicate consonants and unnaturally precise controlled timing. Intellectually superior, remote, patient and quietly authoritative, with restrained faint amusement and occasional sharp emphasis. Distinct from a sibilant politician: broader slower resonant phrases and extremely clear diction. Ordinary close conversational volume, no booming announcer, monster growl, breath apparatus sound, gasping, electronic filter or music. Preserve natural human intelligibility and subtle emotion.

protocol_vesper.name: Protocol Unit Vesper
protocol_vesper.direction: An original male household protocol droid with a clear middle-low British register, cultivated non-rhotic English, smooth narrow dry resonance, meticulously articulated consonants and level precise syllables. Quiet, formal, efficient and politely impersonal, a small deliberate fall at each sentence ending. Distinct from a high anxious comic droid: composed administrative courtesy with minimal emotional variation, but flowing connected intelligible speech. No vocoder, robot buzz, metallic sound effects, echo, music or background noise. A clean dry studio voice.

elara_fenn.name: Elara Fenn
elara_fenn.direction: An original adult woman speaking clear British English in a soft middle register, with light forward resonance, a gentle dry airy edge and delicate precise consonants. Vulnerable, frightened of being left alone, intimate and sincere with a slight hesitant onset and connected natural vowels. Keep the words fully voiced and understandable, quietly emotional rather than a breathy whisper or melodramatic sob. No crying sound effects, electronic processing, room noise, music or reverb. Clean dry close studio dialogue.

nerys_bell.name: Nerys Bell
nerys_bell.direction: An original adult female medical transport captain speaking clear English with a light neutral British accent. A warm middle register, focused forward resonance with a small dry grain, compact precise consonants and natural flowing vowels. Professional, practical and conscientious, politely questioning an unexpected order, with restrained concern under calm control. Subtle uncertainty and urgency without shouting, melodrama, military barking or a breathy whisper. Natural intimate dialogue, comfortable clear listening, clean dry studio sound with no radio filter, music, effects or background noise.

adrian_holt_vd.name: Adrian Holt
adrian_holt_vd.direction: An adult male Imperial officer in his late thirties speaking formal British English. Firm low-middle pitch, focused front-of-mouth resonance, slightly narrow dry vowels and a tight, restrained throat texture. Exceptionally crisp t, k and s consonants, compact military stresses and evenly connected clauses with brief exact pauses. A calm administrative order, precise and impersonal with quiet authority, not an announcer or a villain's growl. Slight natural vocal grain; no radio filtering, static, echoes, distortion or robotic effects. Clear human speech at normal conversational volume.

A warm rounded middle-low baritone, smooth chest resonance with a fine natural dry grain, gentle forward clarity and relaxed precise consonants. Connected American vowels, unhurried conversational phrasing and soft conclusive endings. A thoughtful, kind father and experienced statesman: affectionate, reassuring, quietly dignified and slightly tired. Keep the voice intimate and human, not an announcer, not a deep booming monarch, not theatrical or whispered. Clean dry studio speech, no music, echo, distortion or background effects.

Very precise t and k consonants, clear s sounds, rounded clipped British vowels and non-rhotic endings. Brisk connected legato phrases with small fussy rises and tidy decisive falls. Politely meticulous and mildly anxious, an expressive fastidious valet explaining a historical fact. Light vocal weight with very little low bass; avoid a rich low butler, an American accent, a flat monotone, a monster voice or a child. Comfortable clear conversational volume and restrained natural expression. Dry studio recording, no ring modulation, robot buzz, vocoder, reverb, static, music or other effects.
